source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    for r, c in markers:
        out[r - 2][c - 2:c + 3] = [5] * 5
        out[r - 1][c - 2] = 2
        out[r - 1][c] = 5
        out[r - 1][c + 2] = 2
        out[r][c - 2] = 2
        out[r][c + 2] = 2
        out[r + 1][c - 2] = 2
        out[r + 1][c + 2] = 2
        out[r + 2] = [2] * w
        out[r + 2][c - 2:c + 3] = [8] * 5
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
